method: Initial isolated fixture -> real renderer input or real native MenuItem callback -> specific HTML/project/settings/files/BrowserWindow/focus/context assertions -> screenshots. Every verify contains H.assert/H.wait. Source data evaluation is read-only and never substitutes window.api or application logic.

owners.lifecycle: Home, About, Help, ReportProblem safe local controls, actual update check, shortcuts, native lifecycle, Window menu and recursive native ownership catalog
owners.documents: Compile, import/export, sync, print/page setup, backups, SaveTemplate detailed options and file formats
owners.editor: Editor text, Edit/Insert/Format native commands, transformations, styles, notes/notation, native editing and spelling
owners.media: Media viewers, scratchpad, audio/TTS/dictation, transcription and external media opening
owners.project: Project settings, inspector, keywords/bookmarks/notes, snapshots, targets/stats/history/team and project AI settings
owners.planning: Corkboard/Outline, reading lenses, split/copyholder/composition, whole-book views and editorial panels
owners.program: Program settings, toolbars, binder/tree/navigation and related document organization
owners.services: AI, research, web services, lookups, translations, accounts, NotebookLM and MCP

native_inventory_policy.recursion: Every source command and generated family is listed below. Each native-inventory-* case recursively reads the actual Electron Menu.items/submenu.items, excludes separators only, assigns exactly one of the eight owners and writes native-<context>.json under H.W. Actual runtime leaves, enabled/checked/role and exact routes supplement this source catalog; generated source possibilities are not asserted present when hidden by applicability.
native_inventory_policy.identity: Canonical registry IDs are retained in source inventory. Electron buildAppMenu currently does not retain id/commandId on MenuItems; runtime canonical IDs are recovered from exact group/label when unique, else null (generated action), never guessed menu:N as canonical. setLineSpacing is a scoped canonical extra.
native_inventory_policy.not_behavior: Native inventory-only cases assert enumeration/uniqueness/ownership, NOT leaf behavior. Delegated leaf effects must be verified by the owning domain's catalog/script. Routing or sending IPC is not a functional pass.
native_inventory_policy.home: Native menu is intentionally empty after closing the project. home-startup-return verifies removal and reopening.
native_inventory_policy.native_visual: Playwright page screenshots omit OS menu/title-bar/dialog chrome. Full popup mouse/hover/keyboard/context-menu visual traversal remains explicitly uncovered pending parent OS-level evidence.
native_inventory_policy.tree_references: native_tree is recursive; leaf entries reference complete native_registry/native_extra_leaves records by source/index and retain owner. No leaf or case was removed by compact formatting.
native_inventory_policy.runtime_context_limit: Source candidates cover all defined leaf families. Actual inventory cases cover eight fixture contexts, not every possible media/plugin/selection/style/provider state; remaining conditional states require owner-domain or parent native evidence.
